title: First real-life neural network walking run
caption: November 6 milestone: the physical 650 g 12-servo Ainekio V2 quadruped walking forward across carpet and reversing cleanly under its trained 200M-step MJX neural network policy.

title: Distilled 107.8 KB on-chip ESP32-P4 MicroDuck student rollout
caption: 2-round DAgger student policy (720→128→64→32→12, 110,432 B int8) fitting inside the ESP32-P4's 128 KB L2 cache, trained with multi-surface slick/carpet friction and simulated 4th-wire ADC rail sag.

title: MicroDuck teacher terrain rollout: sloped ramps, steps, rocks, slip & pushes
caption: Full-CAD 650 g Ainekio V2 traversing sloped ramps, discrete steps, rocks, low-friction slip zones, and lateral push disturbances under the 512-256-128 MicroDuck teacher policy.

title: 200M-step centered-stride & upright reverse rollout (Run #5)
caption: Resolved full-CAD MuJoCo policy after fixing tiny hops and reverse dragging: 56.6–63.7 mm centered fore-aft stride, 3.5× higher foot air-time credit, and upright reverse walking (0.072 m torso height, zero rear scoot).

title: RL failure mode: 'Scootybooty' reverse dragging (Run #4)
caption: Intermediate 200M-step rollout before stance centering: the policy parked in an asymmetric split stance and dropped its rear end to 0.044 m to scoot backward instead of lifting its rear feet.

title: RL failure mode: rapid tiny hops (35M-step rollout)
caption: Early 35M-step full-CAD rollout where narrow action scaling produced rapid miniature hops (20–27 mm foot swing) rather than full four-bar strides.

title: 200M-step JAX/Brax/MJX PPO training curve
caption: Evaluation episode reward curve across 201.5 million MJX environment steps for the centered-stride neural gait policy (28.97 ± 13.18 reward).

title: Onboard camera: carpet walking trial
caption: November 2 physical forward-refinement trial recorded from Ainekio's onboard OV5647 CSI camera (with 180° firmware rotation and motion-safe 10,000 µs exposure ceiling) while testing native-C imitation gait updates on carpet.

title: Stock Pupper V3 MuJoCo RL baseline
caption: November 5 reference simulation: the upstream Pupper V3 policy walking +1.68 m forward in MuJoCo as the verified quadruped RL baseline before transferring to the Ainekio MJX four-bar model.

title: Ainekio full-CAD MuJoCo MJCF model
caption: November 5 MuJoCo model exported directly from the V2 Blender CAD assembly (0.650 kg, 12 servo actuators, 8 passive hinges, and 4 planar four-bar equality constraints) for JAX/Brax/MJX gait training.
